svg.title: Reference architecture
svg.text: FedRAMP Moderate-aligned AWS foundation · written from public standards, no employer environment described
Pod security standards · network policies · secrets envelope encryption
Object Lock COMPLIANCE cannot be bypassed
— not by a privileged role, not by root.
GOVERNANCE can. The mode is the control.
Every module declares its controls in controls.yaml; docs/control-coverage.md is generated from them.
